rules: A workflow name, path, previous run, or planned code tree does not bind a new execution.
Read the final published workflow body; preserve all original jobs, selectors, budgets, retries and skip expressions.
Nineteen is the historical original-workflow roster, not a claim that every new event will schedule all nineteen.
NOT_TRIGGERED, scope-skipped, queued, actual-running, terminal and artifact-missing remain distinct.
Local reusable workflow expansion must not be counted as a separate parent run.
